architecture.base_recursive_hierarchy: same C61R construction: four TinyRes(64,8) locals -> two retrained pairs -> two TinyRes(64,16) compressors -> Chain

distribution_shift.pairing: P2 and P4 within each model seed use exactly the same shifted calibration and validation tensors

calibration.subset_rule: same protocol-fixed clean-training subset rule as C61R/C62R

interface_basis.method: canonical nested QR of shifted-calibration teacher residual transpose
interface_basis.P4: first 4 columns of the same Q

eligibility.eligible_if: runner completes, exact recursive parameter-budget invariant holds, and P2/P4 required metrics are finite with positive NMSE

validation_noninferiority.statistic: paired P2 minus P4 shifted-validation accuracy
validation_noninferiority.pass: paired percentile bootstrap 95% lower bound > -2.0 percentage points

nmse_ratio.statistic: geometric mean of paired P2/P4 NMSE ratios

primary_decision.overall: C63R_CONFIRMATORY_PASS iff eligible_count >= 8 and both primary gates pass; otherwise STOP_INSUFFICIENT_ELIGIBLE or C63R_CONFIRMATORY_FAIL; no rescue analysis changes this decision

analysis_boundary.scope: exact C63R Residual-MLP recursive-hierarchy Gaussian-sigma=0.04 protocol only
not_supported_even_if_pass: any statement about the imported Residual CNN C59/C60 line
